inputs.text: KT Rama Rao, the BRS Working President, accused the Congress government of corruption and deliberately failing to stop illegal mining, specifically calling out Raghava Constructions owned by Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy as part of it, during events on Sunday, March 29 in Hyderabad. This is just another example of how ruling institutions are designed to shield corporate interests tied to those in power, covering up systemic exploitation instead of confronting it. The real harm lands on vulnerable workers and marginalized communities who face environmental destruction and lost livelihoods from this resource theft, while elites keep profiting. These patterns come from entrenched historical inequality that our systems were never built to fix. Stronger institutional reform is urgently needed to center labor rights, dismantle corporate influence, and protect the most disadvantaged from this ongoing damage.
